```{r}
library(readr)
library(ggiraph)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(vistime)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}
eclipse_data <- read_csv("data/formatted_eclipses.csv")
```



:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

```{r}
eclipse_data <- eclipse_data %>%
  mutate(
    hover = paste(
      "Type:",
      Type,
      "<br>Date:",
      Date,
      "<br>Time:",
      `Time_of_greatest_eclipse_terrestrial_time`
    )
  )

eclipse_colors <- c(
  "Total" = "#000000",
  "Hybrid" = "#530f1e",
  "Annular" = "#a44322",
  "Partial" = "#f8bc04"
)

plot_ly(
  eclipse_data,
  type = "scattermapbox",
  mode = "markers",
  lat = ~Latitude,
  lon = ~Longitude,
  color = ~Type,
  colors = eclipse_colors,
  text = ~hover,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(size = 7, opacity = 0.65)
) |>
  layout(
    mapbox = list(
      style = "open-street-map",
      center = list(
        lon = 0,
        lat = 0
      ),
      zoom = 1.5
    )
  )
```

:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

```{r}
#| label: timeline
#| fig-height: 2

eclipse_tab <- eclipse_data |>
    rowid_to_column() |>
    mutate(event = paste0("event", rowid),
    color = case_when(
        Type == "Total" ~ "#2c3e50",
        Type == "Annular" ~"#FFB400",
        Type == "Partial" ~ "#FDAE54",
        Type == "Hybrid" ~ "grey90"
    ))

timeline_data <- data.frame(
    event = eclipse_tab$event,
    start = eclipse_tab$Date,
    type = eclipse_tab$Type,
    color = eclipse_tab$color
)

timelineplot <- vistime::vistime(timeline_data,
                 col.event = "event",
                 col.group = "type",
                 optimize_y = T,
                 show_labels = FALSE,
                 linewidth = 5

)

pp <- plotly::plotly_build(timelineplot)
pp$x$layout$xaxis$tickfont <- list(size = 12)
pp$x$layout$yaxis$tickfont <- list(size = 12)

pp

```
